name: merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request, or a stack up to and including it. On a stacked pull request this lands every open pull request from the stack root through this one in one commit (one squash commit with squash, one merge commit otherwise); Origin checks every member first and lands nothing if one is blocked. Where a merge queue owns the branch, a single pull request is queued instead, and nothing lands yet. To land a stack one pull request at a time, merge the lowest open one each time; each becomes its own commit, and the ones above usually need a restack after each landing. Requires the expected head SHA of this pull request. Optional mergeMethod (merge or squash); omit it and Origin picks a method the repository accepts. mergedPrefix lists every pull request that landed. Pull requests above the target stay open; skippedDescendants is currently always empty.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

mergeMethod.description: merge or squash. Omit for the repository default.
